executable is, you must reimplement it from behavioral observation alone.

# jplot

Jplot tracks expvar-like (JSON) metrics and plot their evolution over time right into your iTerm2, Kitty terminal, or terminals with DRCS Sixel Graphics support.

![](doc/demo.gif)

Above capture is jplot monitoring a Go service's expvar:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars \
    memstats.HeapSys+memstats.HeapAlloc+memstats.HeapIdle+marker,counter:memstats.NumGC \
    counter:memstats.TotalAlloc \
    memstats.HeapObjects \
    memstats.StackSys+memstats.StackInuse
```

By default, jplot uses the full size of the terminal, but it is possible to limit the render to a few rows:

![](doc/rows.gif)

## Install

Using homebrew:

```
brew install rs/tap/jplot
```

This tool works with [iTerm2](https://www.iterm2.com), [Kitty](https://sw.kovidgoyal.net/kitty/), [Warp](https://www.warp.dev/), or terminals that support DRCS Sixel Graphics.

## Usage

Given the following JSON output:

```
{
    "mem": {
        "Heap": 1234,
        "Sys": 4321,
        "Stack": 203
    },
    "cpu": {
        "STime": 123,
        "UTime":1234
    },
    "Threads": 2
}
```

You can graph the number of thread over time:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars Threads
```

![](doc/single.png)

Or create a graph with both Utime and Stime growth rate on the same axis by using `+` between two field paths:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars counter:cpu.STime+counter:cpu.UTime
```

Note: the `counter:` prefix instructs jplot to compute the difference between the values instead of showing their absolute value.

![](doc/dual.png)


Or create several graphs by providing groups of fields as separate arguments; each argument creates a new graph:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars mem.Heap+mem.Sys+mem.Stack counter:cpu.STime+cpu.UTime Threads
```

![](doc/all.png)

### Spec Syntax

Each positional arguments given to jplot create a stacked graph with the specified values. To reference the values, use JSON query syntax. Several value paths can be referenced for the same graph by using the `+` character to separate them.

In addition, each value path can be prefixed with options separated from the path by a column. Several options can be used for the same command by separating them with a comma like so: `option1,option2:value.path`.

Supported options are:
* `counter`: Computes the difference with the last value. The value must increase monotonically.
* `marker`: When the value is none-zero, a vertical line is drawn.

## Recipes

### Memstats

Here is an example command to graph a Go program memstats:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars \
    memstats.HeapSys+memstats.HeapAlloc+memstats.HeapIdle+marker,counter:memstats.NumGC \
    counter:memstats.TotalAlloc \
    memstats.HeapObjects \
    memstats.StackSys+memstats.StackInuse
```

![](doc/memstats.png)

### Vegeta

With the help of jaggr, jplot can be used to integrate vegeta as follow:

```
echo 'GET http://localhost:8080' | \
    vegeta attack -rate 5000 -workers 100 -duration 10m | vegeta dump | \
    jaggr @count=rps \
          hist\[100,200,300,400,500\]:code \
          p25,p50,p95:latency \
          sum:bytes_in \
          sum:bytes_out | \
    jplot rps+code.hist.100+code.hist.200+code.hist.300+code.hist.400+code.hist.500 \
          latency.p95+latency.p50+latency.p25 \
          bytes_in.sum+bytes_out.sum
```

![](doc/vegeta.gif)

### Supported Terminals

* [xterm](http://invisible-island.net/xterm/)
* [iTerm2](https://www.iterm2.com/) on OSX
* [Kitty](https://sw.kovidgoyal.net/kitty/) on Linux/macOS/Windows
* [Warp](https://www.warp.dev/) on Linux/macOS/Windows
* [mintty](https://mintty.github.io/) on UNIX OSs via SSH
* [mlterm](https://sourceforge.net/projects/mlterm/) on Linux and Windows
* [RLogin](http://nanno.dip.jp/softlib/man/rlogin/) on Windows
* [yaft](http://uobikiemukot.github.io/yaft/) on Linux console
* [yaft-android](https://github.com/uobikiemukot/yaft-android) on Android
* [Tanasinn](http://saitoha.github.io/tanasinn/) on Firefox/Thunderbird

With the help of jaggr, jplot can be used to integrate vegeta as follow:

```
echo 'GET http://localhost:8080' | \
    vegeta attack -rate 5000 -workers 100 -duration 10m | vegeta dump | \
    jaggr @count=rps \
          hist\[100,200,300,400,500\]:code \
          p25,p50,p95:latency \
          sum:bytes_in \
          sum:bytes_out | \
    jplot rps+code.hist.100+code.hist.200+code.hist.300+code.hist.400+code.hist.500 \
          latency.p95+latency.p50+latency.p25 \
          bytes_in.sum+bytes_out.sum
```

![](doc/vegeta.gif)

### Supported Terminals

* [xterm](http://invisible-island.net/xterm/)
* [iTerm2](https://www.iterm2.com/) on OSX
* [Kitty](https://sw.kovidgoyal.net/kitty/) on Linux/macOS/Windows
* [Warp](https://www.warp.dev/) on Linux/macOS/Windows
* [mintty](https://mintty.github.io/) on UNIX OSs via SSH
* [mlterm](https://sourceforge.net/projects/mlterm/) on Linux and Windows
* [RLogin](http://nanno.dip.jp/softlib/man/rlogin/) on Windows
* [yaft](http://uobikiemukot.github.io/yaft/) on Linux console
* [yaft-android](https://github.com/uobikiemukot/yaft-android) on Android
* [Tanasinn](http://saitoha.github.io/tanasinn/) on Firefox/Thunderbird

        stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
        stdout=slave,
        stderr=slave,

    )

    try:
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(master, 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            data += chunk
    except:
        pass
    
    process.terminate()
    t.join()
    print(repr(data[:500]))

    close_fds=True
)

        data = '{{"cpu": {}}}\n'.format(50 + i*10).encode()

t = threading.Thread(target=writer)
t.daemon = True
t.start()

# Read output
output = b''
deadline = time.time() + 5
while time.time() < deadline:
    r, _, _ = select.select([master_fd], [], [], 0.5)
    if r:
        try:
            chunk = os.read(master_fd, 4096)
            if chunk:
                output += chunk
        except OSError:
            break

proc.terminate()
t.join(timeout=1)

import pty, os, subprocess, sys, time, threading, select, base64

master_fd, slave_fd = pty.openpty()
import fcntl, termios, struct
size = struct.pack("HHHH", 24, 80, 0, 0)
fcntl.ioctl(slave_fd, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, size)

env = os.environ.copy()
env['TERM_PROGRAM'] = 'iTerm.app'
env['TERM'] = 'xterm-256color'

stdin_r, stdin_w = os.pipe()

proc = subprocess.Popen(
    ['./executable', '-steps', '5', 'cpu'],
    stdin=stdin_r,
    stdout=slave_fd,
    stderr=slave_fd,
    env=env,
    close_fds=True
)

os.close(slave_fd)
os.close(stdin_r)

output_all = b''

def reader():
    global output_all
    deadline = time.time() + 8
    while time.time() < deadline:
        r, _, _ = select.select([master_fd], [], [], 0.3)
        if r:
            try:
                chunk = os.read(master_fd, 65536)
                if chunk:
                    output_all += chunk
            except OSError:
                break

rt = threading.Thread(target=reader)
rt.daemon = True
rt.start()

def writer():
    time.sleep(0.3)
    response = b'\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize=15.0;8.0\x07'
    os.write(master_fd, response)
    
    time.sleep(0.5)
    for i in range(3):
        data = '{{"cpu": {}}}\n'.format(50 + i*10).encode()
        os.write(stdin_w, data)
        time.sleep(0.5)
    os.close(stdin_w)

t = threading.Thread(target=writer)
t.daemon = True
t.start()

time.sleep(7)
proc.terminate()
t.join(timeout=1)
rt.join(timeout=1)

# Find the image data
prefix = b'\x1b]1337;File=preserveAspectRatio=1;width=640px;height=360px;inline=1:'
end_marker = b'\x07'

idx = output_all.find(prefix)
if idx >= 0:
    start = idx + len(prefix)
    end = output_all.find(end_marker, start)
    if end >= 0:
        img_b64 = output_all[start:end]
        img_data = base64.b64decode(img_b64)
        with open('/tmp/chart.png', 'wb') as f:
            f.write(img_data)
        print(f"Saved chart.png, size: {len(img_data)} bytes")
        # Show PNG header
        print(f"PNG header: {img_data[:8].hex()}")
        print(f"PNG chunks info:")
        # Parse PNG
        pos = 8
        while pos < len(img_data):
            length = int.from_bytes(img_data[pos:pos+4], 'big')
            chunk_type = img_data[pos+4:pos+8].decode('ascii', errors='replace')
            print(f"  Chunk: {chunk_type}, len={length}")
            pos += 12 + length
            if chunk_type == 'IEND':
                break
    else:
        print("No end marker found")
else:
    print("No image found")
    print("output_all repr:", repr(output_all[:500]))

    chunk_data = data[pos+8:pos+8+chunk_len]

    if chunk_type == b'IDAT':

    elif pb <= pc:
        return b
    else:
        return c

rows = []
for y in range(height):
    row_start = y * row_size
    filter_byte = raw[row_start]
    row = list(raw[row_start+1:row_start+1+4*width])
    
    if filter_byte == 0:  # None
        pass
    elif filter_byte == 1:  # Sub
        for x in range(4, len(row)):
            row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-4]) & 0xFF
    elif filter_byte == 2:  # Up
        if y > 0:
            prev = rows[-1]
            row = [(row[x] + prev[x]) & 0xFF for x in range(len(row))]
    elif filter_byte == 3:  # Average
        if y > 0:
            prev = rows[-1]
            for x in range(len(row)):
                a = row[x-4] if x >= 4 else 0
                b = prev[x]
                row[x] = (row[x] + (a + b) // 2) & 0xFF
        else:
            for x in range(4, len(row)):
                row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-4] // 2) & 0xFF
    elif filter_byte == 4:  # Paeth
        if y > 0:
            prev = rows[-1]
            for x in range(len(row)):
                a = row[x-4] if x >= 4 else 0
                b = prev[x]
                c = prev[x-4] if x >= 4 else 0
                row[x] = (row[x] + paeth(a, b, c)) & 0xFF
        else:
            for x in range(4, len(row)):
                row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-4]) & 0xFF

    row = rows[y]
    return (row[x*4], row[x*4+1], row[x*4+2], row[x*4+3])

print(f"  (320,0): {get_pixel(320,0)}")
print(f"  (0,180): {get_pixel(0,180)}")
print(f"  (320,180): {get_pixel(320,180)}")

print(f"  (639,359): {get_pixel(639,359)}")

for y in range(0, height, 2):

        # Round to nearest 10

import pty, os, subprocess, sys, time, threading, select, base64, struct, zlib

def decode_png(png_data):
    assert png_data[:8] == b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
    ihdr_len = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[8:12])[0]
    ihdr_data = png_data[16:16+ihdr_len]
    width, height = struct.unpack('>II', ihdr_data[:8])
    color_type = ihdr_data[9]
    
    pos = 8
    idat_data = b''
    while pos < len(png_data) - 12:
        chunk_len = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[pos:pos+4])[0]
        chunk_type = png_data[pos+4:pos+8]
        chunk_data = png_data[pos+8:pos+8+chunk_len]
        pos += 12 + chunk_len
        if chunk_type == b'IDAT':
            idat_data += chunk_data
    
    raw = zlib.decompress(idat_data)
    channels = 4  # RGBA
    row_size = 1 + channels * width
    
    def paeth(a, b, c):
        p = a + b - c
        pa = abs(p - a)
        pb = abs(p - b)
        pc = abs(p - c)
        if pa <= pb and pa <= pc:
            return a
        elif pb <= pc:
            return b
        return c
    
    rows = []
    for y in range(height):
        row_start = y * row_size
        filter_byte = raw[row_start]
        row = list(raw[row_start+1:row_start+1+channels*width])
        
        if filter_byte == 0:
            pass
        elif filter_byte == 1:
            for x in range(channels, len(row)):
                row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels]) & 0xFF
        elif filter_byte == 2:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                row = [(row[x] + prev[x]) & 0xFF for x in range(len(row))]
        elif filter_byte == 3:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                for x in range(len(row)):
                    a = row[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                    b = prev[x]
                    row[x] = (row[x] + (a + b) // 2) & 0xFF
            else:
                for x in range(channels, len(row)):
                    row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels] // 2) & 0xFF
        elif filter_byte == 4:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                for x in range(len(row)):
                    a = row[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                    b = prev[x]
                    c = prev[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                    row[x] = (row[x] + paeth(a, b, c)) & 0xFF
            else:
                for x in range(channels, len(row)):
                    row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels]) & 0xFF
        
        rows.append(row)
    
    def get_pixel(x, y):
        row = rows[y]
        return tuple(row[x*channels:x*channels+channels])
    
    return width, height, get_pixel

    assert png_data[:8] == b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
    ihdr_len = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[8:12])[0]
    ihdr_data = png_data[16:16+ihdr_len]
    width, height = struct.unpack('>II', ihdr_data[:8])
    color_type = ihdr_data[9]
    
    pos = 8
    idat_data = b''
    while pos < len(png_data) - 12:
        chunk_len = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[pos:pos+4])[0]
        chunk_type = png_data[pos+4:pos+8]
        chunk_data = png_data[pos+8:pos+8+chunk_len]
        pos += 12 + chunk_len
        if chunk_type == b'IDAT':
            idat_data += chunk_data
    
    raw = zlib.decompress(idat_data)
    channels = 4  # RGBA
    row_size = 1 + channels * width
    
    def paeth(a, b, c):
        p = a + b - c
        pa = abs(p - a)
        pb = abs(p - b)
        pc = abs(p - c)
        if pa <= pb and pa <= pc:
            return a
        elif pb <= pc:
            return b
        return c
    
    rows = []
    for y in range(height):
        row_start = y * row_size
        filter_byte = raw[row_start]
        row = list(raw[row_start+1:row_start+1+channels*width])
        
        if filter_byte == 0:
            pass
        elif filter_byte == 1:
            for x in range(channels, len(row)):
                row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels]) & 0xFF
        elif filter_byte == 2:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                row = [(row[x] + prev[x]) & 0xFF for x in range(len(row))]
        elif filter_byte == 3:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                for x in range(len(row)):
                    a = row[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                    b = prev[x]
                    row[x] = (row[x] + (a + b) // 2) & 0xFF
            else:
                for x in range(channels, len(row)):
                    row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels] // 2) & 0xFF
        elif filter_byte == 4:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                for x in range(len(row)):
                    a = row[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                    b = prev[x]
                    c = prev[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                    row[x] = (row[x] + paeth(a, b, c)) & 0xFF
            else:
                for x in range(channels, len(row)):
                    row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels]) & 0xFF
        
        rows.append(row)
    
    def get_pixel(x, y):
        row = rows[y]
        return tuple(row[x*channels:x*channels+channels])
    
    return width, height, get_pixel

def get_last_image(field_specs, data_values):

        if idx < 0:

def decode_png_to_pixels(png_data):
    assert png_data[:8] == b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
    ihdr_data = png_data[16:29]
    width, height = struct.unpack('>II', ihdr_data[:8])
    
    pos = 8
    idat_data = b''
    while pos < len(png_data) - 12:
        chunk_len = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[pos:pos+4])[0]
        chunk_type = png_data[pos+4:pos+8]
        chunk_data = png_data[pos+8:pos+8+chunk_len]
        pos += 12 + chunk_len
        if chunk_type == b'IDAT':
            idat_data += chunk_data
    
    raw = zlib.decompress(idat_data)
    channels = 4
    row_size = 1 + channels * width
    
    def paeth(a, b, c):
        p = a + b - c
        pa = abs(p - a)
        pb = abs(p - b)
        pc = abs(p - c)
        if pa <= pb and pa <= pc: return a
        elif pb <= pc: return b
        return c
    
    rows = []
    for y in range(height):
        row_start = y * row_size
        f = raw[row_start]
        row = bytearray(raw[row_start+1:row_start+1+channels*width])
        
        if f == 0: pass
        elif f == 1:
            for x in range(channels, len(row)):
                row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels]) & 0xFF
        elif f == 2:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                for x in range(len(row)):
                    row[x] = (row[x] + prev[x]) & 0xFF
        elif f == 3:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                for x in range(len(row)):
                    a = row[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                    row[x] = (row[x] + (a + prev[x]) // 2) & 0xFF
            else:
                for x in range(channels, len(row)):
                    row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels] // 2) & 0xFF
        elif f == 4:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                for x in range(len(row)):
                    a = row[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                    b = prev[x]
                    c = prev[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                    row[x] = (row[x] + paeth(a, b, c)) & 0xFF
            else:
                for x in range(channels, len(row)):

def run_and_get_last_image(field_specs, n_data=6):
    master_fd, slave_fd = pty.openpty()

    env = os.environ.copy()
    env['TERM_PROGRAM'] = 'iTerm.app'
    
    stdin_r, stdin_w = os.pipe()

    )

    os.close(stdin_r)

            if r:

                    if chunk:
                        all_data += chunk
                except OSError:
                    break

    rt.daemon = True

import pty, os, subprocess, sys, time, threading, select, base64, struct, zlib
from collections import Counter

def decode_png_pixels(png_data):
    pos = 8
    idat = b''
    while pos < len(png_data) - 12:
        cl = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[pos:pos+4])[0]
        ct = png_data[pos+4:pos+8]
        cd = png_data[pos+8:pos+8+cl]
        pos += 12 + cl
        if ct == b'IDAT':
            idat += cd
    
    w = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[16:20])[0]
    h = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[20:24])[0]
    raw = zlib.decompress(idat)
    
    def paeth(a, b, c):
        p = a + b - c
        pa, pb, pc = abs(p-a), abs(p-b), abs(p-c)
        if pa <= pb and pa <= pc: return a
        elif pb <= pc: return b
        return c
    
    channels = 4
    row_size = 1 + channels * w
    rows = []
    for y in range(h):
        rs = y * row_size
        f = raw[rs]
        row = bytearray(raw[rs+1:rs+1+channels*w])
        if f == 1:
            for x in range(channels, len(row)): row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels]) & 0xFF
        elif f == 2:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                for x in range(len(row)): row[x] = (row[x] + prev[x]) & 0xFF
        elif f == 3:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                for x in range(len(row)):
                    a = row[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                    row[x] = (row[x] + (a + prev[x]) // 2) & 0xFF
            else:
                for x in range(channels, len(row)): row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels] // 2) & 0xFF
        elif f == 4:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                for x in range(len(row)):
                    a = row[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                    b = prev[x]
                    c = prev[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                    row[x] = (row[x] + paeth(a, b, c)) & 0xFF
            else:
                for x in range(channels, len(row)): row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels]) & 0xFF
        rows.append(bytes(row))
    
    def get(x, y): return tuple(rows[y][x*4:x*4+4])
    return w, h, get

with open('/tmp/six_series.png', 'rb') as f:
    png = f.read()

w, h, get = decode_png_pixels(png)
print(f"Image: {w}x{h}")

colors = Counter()
for y in range(h):

        r, g, b, a = get(x, y)
        if a > 200:

                if not (abs(r-g) < 25 and abs(g-b) < 25 and abs(r-b) < 25):

def decode_png_pixels(png_data):
    pos = 8
    idat = b''
    while pos < len(png_data) - 12:
        cl = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[pos:pos+4])[0]
        ct = png_data[pos+4:pos+8]
        cd = png_data[pos+8:pos+8+cl]
        pos += 12 + cl
        if ct == b'IDAT':
            idat += cd
    w = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[16:20])[0]
    h = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[20:24])[0]
    raw = zlib.decompress(idat)
    def paeth(a, b, c):
        p = a + b - c
        pa, pb, pc = abs(p-a), abs(p-b), abs(p-c)
        if pa <= pb and pa <= pc: return a
        elif pb <= pc: return b
        return c
    channels = 4
    row_size = 1 + channels * w
    rows = []
    for y in range(h):
        rs = y * row_size
        f = raw[rs]
        row = bytearray(raw[rs+1:rs+1+channels*w])
        if f == 1:
            for x in range(channels, len(row)): row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels]) & 0xFF
        elif f == 2:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                for x in range(len(row)): row[x] = (row[x] + prev[x]) & 0xFF
        elif f == 3:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                for x in range(len(row)):
                    a = row[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                    row[x] = (row[x] + (a + prev[x]) // 2) & 0xFF
            else:
                for x in range(channels, len(row)): row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels] // 2) & 0xFF
        elif f == 4:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                for x in range(len(row)):
                    a = row[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                    b = prev[x]
                    c = prev[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                    row[x] = (row[x] + paeth(a, b, c)) & 0xFF
            else:
                for x in range(channels, len(row)): row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels]) & 0xFF

            if r:

                    if chunk: all_data += chunk
                except: break

    rt.daemon = True
    rt.start()

            if color != prev_color:

                prev_color = color

        pa, pb, pc = abs(p-a), abs(p-b), abs(p-c)
        if pa <= pb and pa <= pc: return a
        elif pb <= pc: return b
        return c
    channels = 4
    row_size = 1 + channels * w

import struct, zlib

def decode_png_pixels(png_data):
    pos = 8
    idat = b''
    while pos < len(png_data) - 12:
        cl = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[pos:pos+4])[0]
        ct = png_data[pos+4:pos+8]
        cd = png_data[pos+8:pos+8+cl]
        pos += 12 + cl
        if ct == b'IDAT':
            idat += cd
    w = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[16:20])[0]
    h = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[20:24])[0]
    raw = zlib.decompress(idat)
    def paeth(a, b, c):
        p = a + b - c
        pa, pb, pc = abs(p-a), abs(p-b), abs(p-c)
        if pa <= pb and pa <= pc: return a
        elif pb <= pc: return b
        return c
    channels = 4
    row_size = 1 + channels * w
    rows = []
    for y in range(h):
        rs = y * row_size
        f = raw[rs]
        row = bytearray(raw[rs+1:rs+1+channels*w])
        if f == 1:
            for x in range(channels, len(row)): row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels]) & 0xFF
        elif f == 2:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                for x in range(len(row)): row[x] = (row[x] + prev[x]) & 0xFF
        elif f == 3:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                for x in range(len(row)):
                    a = row[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                    row[x] = (row[x] + (a + prev[x]) // 2) & 0xFF
            else:
                for x in range(channels, len(row)): row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels] // 2) & 0xFF
        elif f == 4:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                for x in range(len(row)):
                    a = row[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                    b = prev[x]
                    c = prev[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                    row[x] = (row[x] + paeth(a, b, c)) & 0xFF
            else:
                for x in range(channels, len(row)): row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels]) & 0xFF
        rows.append(bytes(row))
    def get(x, y): 
        if y < len(rows) and x*4+4 <= len(rows[y]):
            row = rows[y]
            return row[x*4], row[x*4+1], row[x*4+2], row[x*4+3]
        return 0, 0, 0, 0
    return w, h, get

import struct, zlib

def decode_png_pixels(png_data):
    pos = 8
    idat = b''
    while pos < len(png_data) - 12:
        cl = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[pos:pos+4])[0]
        ct = png_data[pos+4:pos+8]
        cd = png_data[pos+8:pos+8+cl]
        pos += 12 + cl
        if ct == b'IDAT':
            idat += cd
    w = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[16:20])[0]
    h = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[20:24])[0]
    raw = zlib.decompress(idat)
    def paeth(a, b, c):
        p = a + b - c
        pa, pb, pc = abs(p-a), abs(p-b), abs(p-c)
        if pa <= pb and pa <= pc: return a
        elif pb <= pc: return b
        return c
    channels = 4
    row_size = 1 + channels * w
    rows = []
    for y in range(h):
        rs = y * row_size
        f = raw[rs]
        row = bytearray(raw[rs+1:rs+1+channels*w])
        if f == 1:
            for x in range(channels, len(row)): row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels]) & 0xFF
        elif f == 2:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                for x in range(len(row)): row[x] = (row[x] + prev[x]) & 0xFF
        elif f == 3:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                for x in range(len(row)):
                    a = row[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                    row[x] = (row[x] + (a + prev[x]) // 2) & 0xFF
            else:
                for x in range(channels, len(row)): row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels] // 2) & 0xFF
        elif f == 4:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                for x in range(len(row)):
                    a = row[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                    b = prev[x]
                    c = prev[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                    row[x] = (row[x] + paeth(a, b, c)) & 0xFF
            else:
                for x in range(channels, len(row)): row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels]) & 0xFF
        rows.append(bytes(row))
    def get(x, y): 
        if y < len(rows) and x*4+4 <= len(rows[y]):

# ESC\_Gi=1,a=q,t=d,f=24\ESC\
# This is querying the Kitty terminal with: 
# a=q (action=query), t=d (?), f=24 (format=24bit)
# i=1 (image id=1)

# 1. arg.go - argument parsing
# 2. jplot.go - main entry point
# 3. graph.go - data management and chart rendering
# 4. term.go - terminal interaction (iTerm2, Kitty, Sixel detection)
# 5. render.go - PNG chart rendering

# Let me look at what data the Kitty protocol expects when it gets a response
# ESC\_Gi=1,a=q,t=d,f=24\ESC\
# The response should be: ESC\_Gi=1,e=0\ESC\ (success)
# OR then we send: ESC\_G<data>\ESC\ to transmit the image

# Actually Kitty sends chunks of base64 encoded image data
# Format: ESC\_G<key=value pairs>,<payload>\ESC\
# Where payload can be split across multiple chunks

import pty, os, subprocess, sys, time, threading, select, struct

fcntl.ioctl(slave_fd, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, sz)
env = os.environ.copy()
env['KITTY_WINDOW_ID'] = '1'
env['TERM'] = 'xterm-kitty'
if 'TERM_PROGRAM' in env:
    del env['TERM_PROGRAM']

proc = subprocess.Popen(['./executable', '-steps', '5', 'a'],
    stdin=stdin_r, stdout=slave_fd, stderr=slave_fd, env=env, close_fds=True)
os.close(slave_fd); os.close(stdin_r)
chunks = []

def reader():
    deadline = time.time() + 10
    while time.time() < deadline:
        r, _, _ = select.select([master_fd], [], [], 0.2)
        if r:
            try:
                chunk = os.read(master_fd, 65536)
                if chunk: chunks.append((time.time(), chunk))
            except: break

rt = threading.Thread(target=reader); rt.daemon=True; rt.start()

def writer():
    time.sleep(0.5)
    # Respond to the Kitty query
    # ESC\_Gi=1,a=q,t=d,f=24\ESC\  -> respond with ESC\_Gi=1,e=0\ESC\
    response = b'\x1b_Gi=1,e=0\x1b\\'

    for i in range(3):
        os.write(stdin_w, b'{"a": 50}\n')
        time.sleep(1.1)

t = threading.Thread(target=writer); t.daemon=True; t.start()

        print(f"[{ts:.2f}] KITTY DATA len={len(chunk)}: {repr(chunk[:100])}")
    else:
        print(f"[{ts:.2f}] control: {repr(chunk[:100])}")

import pty, os, subprocess, sys, time, threading, select, struct, base64

def get_kitty_image_dims(cols, rows, cell_w, cell_h):
    master_fd, slave_fd = pty.openpty()
    import fcntl, termios
    # Set terminal size with pixel dimensions
    sz = struct.pack("HHHH", rows, cols, cols*cell_w, rows*cell_h)
    fcntl.ioctl(slave_fd, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, sz)
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env['KITTY_WINDOW_ID'] = '1'
    env['TERM'] = 'xterm-kitty'
    if 'TERM_PROGRAM' in env:
        del env['TERM_PROGRAM']
    stdin_r, stdin_w = os.pipe()
    
    proc = subprocess.Popen(['./executable', '-steps', '5', 'a'],
        stdin=stdin_r, stdout=slave_fd, stderr=slave_fd, env=env, close_fds=True)
    os.close(slave_fd); os.close(stdin_r)
    all_data = b''
    
    def reader():
        nonlocal all_data
        deadline = time.time() + 10
        while time.time() < deadline:
            r, _, _ = select.select([master_fd], [], [], 0.2)
            if r:
                try:
                    chunk = os.read(master_fd, 65536)
                    if chunk: all_data += chunk
                except: break
    
    rt = threading.Thread(target=reader); rt.daemon=True; rt.start()
    
    def writer():
        time.sleep(0.5)
        os.write(master_fd, b'\x1b_Gi=1,e=0\x1b\\')
        time.sleep(0.2)
        os.write(master_fd, b'\x1b[?62;1;22c')
        time.sleep(0.3)
        # Respond to ESC[14t
        size_response = f'\x1b[4;{rows*cell_h};{cols*cell_w}t'.encode()
        os.write(master_fd, size_response)
        time.sleep(0.5)
        os.write(stdin_w, b'{"a": 50}\n')
        time.sleep(1.5)
        os.close(stdin_w)
    
    t = threading.Thread(target=writer); t.daemon=True; t.start()
    time.sleep(6); proc.terminate(); t.join(timeout=1); rt.join(timeout=1)
    
    # Find Kitty image data
    idx = all_data.find(b'\x1b_Ga=T')
    if idx < 0:
        return None, None
    # Find the payload start
    sc = all_data.find(b';', idx)
    end = all_data.find(b'\x1b\\', sc)
    if sc < 0 or end < 0:
        return None, None
    payload = all_data[sc+1:end]
    # Reconstruct PNG (skip until next chunk if needed)
    full_b64 = payload
    pos = end + 2
    while True:
        idx2 = all_data.find(b'\x1b_G', pos)
        if idx2 < 0:
            break
        sc2 = all_data.find(b';', idx2)
        end2 = all_data.find(b'\x1b\\', sc2)
        if sc2 < 0 or end2 < 0:
            break
        full_b64 += all_data[sc2+1:end2]
        pos = end2 + 2
        # Check if this is a new image (different i=X)
        header = all_data[idx2:sc2].decode('ascii', errors='replace')
        if 'a=T' in header:
            break  # New image started
    
    try:
        png_data = base64.b64decode(full_b64 + b'==')
        if len(png_data) < 24:
            return None, None
        w = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[16:20])[0]
        h = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[20:24])[0]
        return w, h
    except:
        return None, None

print("Kitty image dimensions for different terminal sizes:")
for cols, rows, cw, ch in [(80, 24, 8, 15), (80, 24, 10, 20), (120, 30, 8, 15)]:
    w, h = get_kitty_image_dims(cols, rows, cw, ch)
    print(f"  {cols}x{rows} term, {cw}x{ch} cell: Kitty image = {w}x{h}")
    print(f"  Expected iTerm2: {cols*cw}x{rows*ch}")
    if w and h:
        print(f"  Diff: ({cols*cw-w})x({rows*ch-h})")

    master_fd, slave_fd = pty.openpty()
    import fcntl, termios
    # Set terminal size with pixel dimensions
    sz = struct.pack("HHHH", rows, cols, cols*cell_w, rows*cell_h)
    fcntl.ioctl(slave_fd, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, sz)
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env['KITTY_WINDOW_ID'] = '1'
    env['TERM'] = 'xterm-kitty'
    if 'TERM_PROGRAM' in env:
        del env['TERM_PROGRAM']
    stdin_r, stdin_w = os.pipe()
    
    proc = subprocess.Popen(['./executable', '-steps', '5', 'a'],
        stdin=stdin_r, stdout=slave_fd, stderr=slave_fd, env=env, close_fds=True)
    os.close(slave_fd); os.close(stdin_r)
    all_data = b''
    
    def reader():
        nonlocal all_data
        deadline = time.time() + 10
        while time.time() < deadline:
            r, _, _ = select.select([master_fd], [], [], 0.2)
            if r:
                try:
                    chunk = os.read(master_fd, 65536)
                    if chunk: all_data += chunk
                except: break
    
    rt = threading.Thread(target=reader); rt.daemon=True; rt.start()
    
    def writer():
        time.sleep(0.5)
        os.write(master_fd, b'\x1b_Gi=1,e=0\x1b\\')
        time.sleep(0.2)
        os.write(master_fd, b'\x1b[?62;1;22c')
        time.sleep(0.3)
        # Respond to ESC[14t
        size_response = f'\x1b[4;{rows*cell_h};{cols*cell_w}t'.encode()
        os.write(master_fd, size_response)
        time.sleep(0.5)
        os.write(stdin_w, b'{"a": 50}\n')
        time.sleep(1.5)
        os.close(stdin_w)
    
    t = threading.Thread(target=writer); t.daemon=True; t.start()
    time.sleep(6); proc.terminate(); t.join(timeout=1); rt.join(timeout=1)
    
    # Find Kitty image data
    idx = all_data.find(b'\x1b_Ga=T')
    if idx < 0:
        return None, None
    # Find the payload start
    sc = all_data.find(b';', idx)
    end = all_data.find(b'\x1b\\', sc)
    if sc < 0 or end < 0:
        return None, None
    payload = all_data[sc+1:end]
    # Reconstruct PNG (skip until next chunk if needed)
    full_b64 = payload
    pos = end + 2
    while True:
        idx2 = all_data.find(b'\x1b_G', pos)
        if idx2 < 0:
            break
        sc2 = all_data.find(b';', idx2)
        end2 = all_data.find(b'\x1b\\', sc2)
        if sc2 < 0 or end2 < 0:
            break
        full_b64 += all_data[sc2+1:end2]
        pos = end2 + 2
        # Check if this is a new image (different i=X)
        header = all_data[idx2:sc2].decode('ascii', errors='replace')
        if 'a=T' in header:
            break  # New image started
    
    try:
        png_data = base64.b64decode(full_b64 + b'==')
        if len(png_data) < 24:
            return None, None
        w = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[16:20])[0]
        h = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[20:24])[0]
        return w, h
    except:
        return None, None

# Clear pattern:
# TERM_PROGRAM=iTerm.app → use iTerm2 protocol
# TERM_PROGRAM=WarpTerminal or other → try Kitty first
#
# So the detection logic is:
# 1. If TERM_PROGRAM == "iTerm.app" → iTerm2 mode

#    - Otherwise, send ESC[c to check for Sixel → ESC[c response with 4 in the list = Sixel mode
#    - Otherwise, error
#
# Wait but the README says "iTerm2, Kitty, or DRCS Sixel Graphics"
# And the error when no terminal is detected includes all three.
# 
# Also, the original binary uses ESC[c to query capabilities and waits for response
# Let me verify: with TERM_PROGRAM=WarpTerminal and sending a Kitty response,
# does it use Kitty protocol?

python3 << 'PYEOF'
import pty, os, subprocess, sys, time, threading, select, struct, base64

def test_warp_kitty():
    master_fd, slave_fd = pty.openpty()
    import fcntl, termios
    sz = struct.pack("HHHH", 24, 80, 640, 360)
    fcntl.ioctl(slave_fd, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, sz)
    env = {'TERM_PROGRAM': 'WarpTerminal', 'HOME': '/tmp', 'PATH': '/usr/bin:/bin'}
    stdin_r, stdin_w = os.pipe()
    
    proc = subprocess.Popen(['./executable', '-steps', '5', 'a'],
        stdin=stdin_r, stdout=slave_fd, stderr=slave_fd, env=env, close_fds=True)
    os.close(slave_fd); os.close(stdin_r)
    all_data = []
    
    def reader():
        deadline = time.time() + 10
        while time.time() < deadline:
            r, _, _ = select.select([master_fd], [], [], 0.1)
            if r:
                try:
                    chunk = os.read(master_fd, 65536)
                    if chunk: all_data.append((time.time(), chunk))
                except: break
    rt = threading.Thread(target=reader); rt.daemon=True; rt.start()
    
    def writer():
        time.sleep(0.5)
        # Respond to Kitty query with OK
        os.write(master_fd, b'\x1b_Gi=1,e=0\x1b\\')
        time.sleep(0.3)
        # Also respond to ESC[c just in case
        os.write(master_fd, b'\x1b[?62;1;22c')
        time.sleep(0.3)
        # Respond to ESC[14t if needed
        os.write(master_fd, b'\x1b[4;360;640t')
        time.sleep(0.5)
        for i in range(2):
            os.write(stdin_w, b'{"a": 50}\n')
            time.sleep(1.1)
        os.close(stdin_w)
    
    t = threading.Thread(target=writer); t.daemon=True; t.start()
    time.sleep(8); proc.terminate(); t.join(timeout=1); rt.join(timeout=1)
    
    print("Warp with Kitty OK response:")
    for ts, chunk in all_data:
        if b'\x1b_G' in chunk:
            print(f"  [{ts:.2f}] KITTY len={len(chunk)}: {repr(chunk[:100])}")
        else:
            print(f"  [{ts:.2f}] ctrl: {repr(chunk[:100])}")

# Let me look at the logic flow again.
# 
# In my detectTerminal():
# 1. Try Kitty (querySupport) - this sends ESC_G regardless of TERM_PROGRAM
# 2. Then check TERM_PROGRAM
# 
# But in the original binary:
# With TERM_PROGRAM=iTerm.app: NO Kitty query is sent, goes directly to iTerm2
# 
# I need to check TERM_PROGRAM FIRST, before trying Kitty.

# Also the error message is wrong - it's showing error because stdin is not a tty
# But with iTerm.app set, it should try to use iTerm2 protocol and get cell size

# Let me also check the exact error handling
# With TERM_PROGRAM=iTerm.app but no tty: "Cannot get window size: inappropriate ioctl for device"
# With no terminal: "iTerm2, Kitty, or DRCS Sixel graphics required"

# Let me fix the detection order and also check what happens when stdin is not a tty

# Actually wait - the issue is that the program is sending Kitty query to stdout (tty)
# but then reading from stdin (which is a pipe)
# The Kitty query response would come on stdin... but stdin has JSON data
# 
# The real program must read from /dev/tty for terminal control sequences
# Let me check how the original handles this

python3 << 'PYEOF'
import pty, os, subprocess, sys, time, threading, select, struct

master_fd, slave_fd = pty.openpty()
import fcntl, termios
sz = struct.pack("HHHH", 24, 80, 0, 0)
fcntl.ioctl(slave_fd, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, sz)
env = {'TERM_PROGRAM': 'iTerm.app', 'HOME': '/tmp', 'PATH': '/usr/bin:/bin'}
stdin_r, stdin_w = os.pipe()  # stdin is a PIPE, not the tty

proc = subprocess.Popen(['./executable', '-steps', '5', 'a'],
    stdin=stdin_r, stdout=slave_fd, stderr=slave_fd, env=env, close_fds=True)
os.close(slave_fd); os.close(stdin_r)
all_data = b''
def reader():
    global all_data
    deadline = time.time() + 5
    while time.time() < deadline:
        r, _, _ = select.select([master_fd], [], [], 0.2)
        if r:
            try:
                chunk = os.read(master_fd, 65536)
                if chunk: all_data += chunk
            except: break
rt = threading.Thread(target=reader); rt.daemon=True; rt.start()
def writer():
    time.sleep(0.3)
    os.write(master_fd, b'\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize=15.0;8.0\x07')
    time.sleep(0.5)
    os.write(stdin_w, b'{"a": 50}\n')
    time.sleep(1.5)
    os.close(stdin_w)
t = threading.Thread(target=writer); t.daemon=True; t.start()
time.sleep(4); proc.terminate(); t.join(timeout=1); rt.join(timeout=1)
print("output:", repr(all_data[:300]))

# BUT: timeout waiting for response!
# The issue is: the debug binary sends query to stdout (the tty slave)
# The response is written to master, which should be readable from /dev/tty
# 
# Wait - the response goes: master -> pty line discipline -> slave
# But the binary reads from /dev/tty which IS the slave
# So reading from /dev/tty should get the response
#
# Actually wait - when we write to master_fd, the data appears on the slave
# BUT: the slave (tty) is in "cooked" mode by default
# In cooked mode, terminal input is line-buffered and echoed
# The ESC sequence would be ECHOED back and partially buffered
# 
# We need raw mode on the tty for proper response reading!
# 
# But also - the response was NOT in the stdout output (all_out) - it only shows:
# ESC]1337;ReportCellSize\x07 (the query) and the echoed response
# The response string "^[]1337;ReportCellSize=15.0;8.0^G" appears to be what was
# written back from master... wait that's confusing.
# 
# Actually looking at the output:
# stdout: b'\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize\x07^[]1337;ReportCellSize=15.0;8.0^G'
# 
# The first part \x1b]1337;ReportCellSize\x07 is the QUERY sent by the binary
# The second part ^[]1337;ReportCellSize=15.0;8.0^G is the RESPONSE being ECHOED
# 
# Since the tty is in cooked/echo mode, when the binary reads from /dev/tty,
# it gets the response. But the raw.go makeRaw() function needs to be called first!
# 
# Let me check if makeRaw in my code is working...
# Actually the binary DOES call makeRaw before reading. But the debug doesn't.
# Let me add raw mode to the debug binary.

# More importantly - in the actual jplot implementation, the issue might be that:
# 1. makeRaw() is called with os.Stdin.Fd() but stdin is a pipe (not a tty)
# 2. TCGETS on a pipe returns ENOTTY
# 3. So makeRaw fails silently
# 4. Without raw mode, reading from /dev/tty might work differently

# Let me check: what fd should makeRaw use?
# It should use the TTY fd, not stdin
# In my raw.go, I'm using os.Stdin.Fd() which is wrong when stdin is a pipe

# Also: the readTTYUntilBEL function reads from ttyReader (which reads from /dev/tty)
# But ttyReader is created from the tty file... that should work after setsid+TIOCSCTTY

# Let me fix raw.go to use the tty fd instead of stdin

package main

import (
	"syscall"
	"unsafe"
)

// Terminal raw mode
type termState struct {
	termios syscall.Termios
	fd      uintptr
}

func makeRaw() (*termState, error) {
	fd := uintptr(1) // stdout
	if tty != nil {
		fd = tty.Fd()
	}
	
	var oldState syscall.Termios
	if _, _, errno := syscall.Syscall(syscall.SYS_IOCTL,
		fd,
		syscall.TCGETS,
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&oldState))); errno != 0 {
		// Not a tty, skip
		return nil, nil
	}
	
	newState := oldState
	// Raw mode
	newState.Lflag &^= syscall.ECHO | syscall.ECHOE | syscall.ECHOK | syscall.ECHONL | 
		syscall.ICANON | syscall.ISIG | syscall.IEXTEN
	newState.Iflag &^= syscall.BRKINT | syscall.ICRNL | syscall.INPCK | syscall.ISTRIP | syscall.IXON
	newState.Cflag |= syscall.CS8
	newState.Oflag &^= syscall.OPOST
	newState.Cc[syscall.VMIN] = 1
	newState.Cc[syscall.VTIME] = 0
	
	if _, _, errno := syscall.Syscall(syscall.SYS_IOCTL,
		fd,
		syscall.TCSETS,
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&newState))); errno != 0 {
		return nil, nil
	}
	
	return &termState{termios: oldState, fd: fd}, nil
}

func restoreRaw(state *termState) {
	if state == nil {
		return
	}
	syscall.Syscall(syscall.SYS_IOCTL,
		state.fd,
		syscall.TCSETS,
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&state.termios)))
}

import pty, os, subprocess, sys, time, threading, select, struct, base64

master_fd, slave_fd = pty.openpty()
import fcntl, termios
sz = struct.pack("HHHH", 24, 80, 0, 0)
fcntl.ioctl(slave_fd, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, sz)
env = os.environ.copy()
env['TERM_PROGRAM'] = 'iTerm.app'

stdin_r, stdin_w = os.pipe()

def preexec():
    os.setsid()
    fcntl.ioctl(slave_fd, termios.TIOCSCTTY, 0)

proc = subprocess.Popen(['/workspace/jplot-test', '-steps', '5', 'a'],
    stdin=stdin_r, stdout=slave_fd, stderr=slave_fd,
    env=env, close_fds=True, preexec_fn=preexec)
os.close(slave_fd); os.close(stdin_r)
all_data = b''

def reader():
    global all_data
    deadline = time.time() + 8
    while time.time() < deadline:
        r, _, _ = select.select([master_fd], [], [], 0.2)
        if r:
            try:
                chunk = os.read(master_fd, 65536)
                if chunk: all_data += chunk
            except: break

rt = threading.Thread(target=reader); rt.daemon=True; rt.start()

def writer():
    time.sleep(0.3)
    os.write(master_fd, b'\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize=15.0;8.0\x07')
    time.sleep(0.5)
    for i in range(3):
        os.write(stdin_w, b'{"a": 50}\n')
        time.sleep(1.1)
    os.close(stdin_w)

t = threading.Thread(target=writer); t.daemon=True; t.start()
time.sleep(7); proc.terminate(); t.join(timeout=1); rt.join(timeout=1)

print("Output length:", len(all_data))
if b'\x1b]1337;File=' in all_data:
    print("SUCCESS: Image found!")
    count = all_data.count(b'\x1b]1337;File=')
    print(f"Images: {count}")
    
    idx = all_data.find(b'\x1b]1337;File=')
    he = all_data.find(b':', idx)
    ep = all_data.find(b'\x07', idx)
    header = all_data[idx:he].decode('ascii')
    img_b64 = all_data[he+1:ep]
    print(f"Header: {header}")
    try:
        img = base64.b64decode(img_b64)
        w = struct.unpack('>I', img[16:20])[0]
        h = struct.unpack('>I', img[20:24])[0]
        print(f"Image size: {w}x{h}")
        with open('/tmp/my_chart.png', 'wb') as f:
            f.write(img)
        print("Saved!")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")
else:
    print("No image!")
    print("Output:", repr(all_data[:500]))
PYEOF

import pty, os, subprocess, sys, time, threading, select, struct, base64

def test_tool(exe):
    master_fd, slave_fd = pty.openpty()
    import fcntl, termios
    sz = struct.pack("HHHH", 24, 80, 0, 0)
    fcntl.ioctl(slave_fd, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, sz)
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env['TERM_PROGRAM'] = 'iTerm.app'

    stdin_r, stdin_w = os.pipe()

    def preexec():
        os.setsid()
        fcntl.ioctl(slave_fd, termios.TIOCSCTTY, 0)

    proc = subprocess.Popen([exe, '-steps', '5', 'a'],
        stdin=stdin_r, stdout=slave_fd, stderr=slave_fd,
        env=env, close_fds=True, preexec_fn=preexec)
    os.close(slave_fd); os.close(stdin_r)
    all_data = b''

    def reader():
        nonlocal all_data
        deadline = time.time() + 6
        while time.time() < deadline:
            r, _, _ = select.select([master_fd], [], [], 0.1)
            if r:
                try:
                    chunk = os.read(master_fd, 65536)
                    if chunk: all_data += chunk
                except: break

    rt = threading.Thread(target=reader); rt.daemon=True; rt.start()

    def writer():
        time.sleep(0.3)
        os.write(master_fd, b'\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize=15.0;8.0\x07')
        time.sleep(0.5)
        for i in range(2):
            os.write(stdin_w, b'{"a": 50}\n')
            time.sleep(1.1)
        os.close(stdin_w)

    t = threading.Thread(target=writer); t.daemon=True; t.start()
    time.sleep(5); proc.terminate(); t.join(timeout=1); rt.join(timeout=1)

    # Clean
    pos = 0
    clean = b''
    img_count = 0
    while pos < len(all_data):
        idx = all_data.find(b'\x1b]1337;File=', pos)
        if idx < 0:
            clean += all_data[pos:]
            break
        clean += all_data[pos:idx]
        end = all_data.find(b'\x07', idx)
        if end < 0: break
        img_count += 1
        clean += f'[IMG_{img_count}]'.encode()
        pos = end + 1
    
    return clean, img_count

orig, orig_count = test_tool('./executable')
mine, mine_count = test_tool('/workspace/jplot-test')

print("ORIGINAL:", repr(orig))
print()
print("MINE:", repr(mine))
print()
print(f"Orig imgs: {orig_count}, Mine: {mine_count}")

func (t *ITerm2Terminal) DisplayImage(imgData []byte, w, h int, isLast bool) error {
	// Try to read updated cell size (non-blocking)
	freshResp := tryReadTTY(50)
	if freshResp != "" {
		if idx := strings.Index(freshResp, "ReportCellSize="); idx >= 0 {
			parts := strings.Split(freshResp[idx+len("ReportCellSize="):], ";")
			if len(parts) >= 2 {
				h2, _ := strconv.ParseFloat(strings.TrimRight(parts[0], "\x07"), 64)
				w2, _ := strconv.ParseFloat(strings.TrimRight(parts[1], "\x07"), 64)
				if h2 > 0 && w2 > 0 {
					t.cellH = h2
					t.cellW = w2
				}
			}
		}
	}

	encoded := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(imgData)
	out := bufio.NewWriter(os.Stdout)
	fmt.Fprintf(out, "\x1b]1337;File=preserveAspectRatio=1;width=%dpx;height=%dpx;inline=1:", w, h)

	out.WriteString("\x07")

	if !isLast {

# - The "isLast" for the second render is determined by stdin closing

package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"encoding/base64"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

// iTerm2 Terminal implementation
type ITerm2Terminal struct {
	cellW float64
	cellH float64
}

func (t *ITerm2Terminal) GetSize() (cols, rows int, err error) {
	ws, err := getWinsize()
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("inappropriate ioctl for device")
	}
	return int(ws.Col), int(ws.Row), nil
}

func (t *ITerm2Terminal) GetPixelSize(cols, rows, rowsFlag int) (int, int, error) {
	// Query cell size from iTerm2 (initial measurement)
	origState, _ := makeRaw()
	
	fmt.Fprint(os.Stdout, "\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize\x07")
	os.Stdout.Sync()
	
	resp := readTTYUntilBEL(500)
	
	if origState != nil {
		restoreRaw(origState)
	}
	
	// Parse: ESC]1337;ReportCellSize=H;W BEL
	if idx := strings.Index(resp, "ReportCellSize="); idx >= 0 {
		parts := strings.Split(resp[idx+len("ReportCellSize="):], ";")
		if len(parts) >= 2 {
			h, _ := strconv.ParseFloat(strings.TrimRight(parts[0], "\x07"), 64)
			w2, _ := strconv.ParseFloat(strings.TrimRight(parts[1], "\x07"), 64)
			t.cellH = h
			t.cellW = w2
		}
	}

	if t.cellH == 0 || t.cellW == 0 {
		ws, err := getWinsize()
		if err == nil && ws.Xpixel > 0 && ws.Ypixel > 0 {
			t.cellW = float64(ws.Xpixel) / float64(ws.Col)
			t.cellH = float64(ws.Ypixel) / float64(ws.Row)
		} else {
			t.cellW = 8
			t.cellH = 15
		}
	}

	imgW := int(t.cellW * float64(cols))
	numRows := rowsFlag
	if numRows == 0 {
		numRows = rows
	}
	imgH := int(t.cellH * float64(numRows))

	return imgW, imgH, nil
}

func (t *ITerm2Terminal) Setup(numRows int) {
	out := bufio.NewWriter(os.Stdout)
	out.WriteString("\x1b[?25l")
	for i := 0; i < numRows; i++ {
		out.WriteString("\n")
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(out, "\x1b[%dA", numRows)
	out.WriteString("\x1b[s")
	// Send cell size query for first render
	out.WriteString("\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize\x07")
	out.Flush()
}

func (t *ITerm2Terminal) DisplayImage(imgData []byte, w, h int, isLast bool) error {
	encoded := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(imgData)
	out := bufio.NewWriter(os.Stdout)
	fmt.Fprintf(out, "\x1b]1337;File=preserveAspectRatio=1;width=%dpx;height=%dpx;inline=1:", w, h)
	out.WriteString(encoded)
	out.WriteString("\x07")
	out.WriteString("\x1b[u")
	if !isLast {
		out.WriteString("\x1b[s")
	}
	out.Flush()
	return nil
}

func (t *ITerm2Terminal) Cleanup(numRows int) {
	out := bufio.NewWriter(os.Stdout)
	out.WriteString("\x1b[?25h")
	fmt.Fprintf(out, "\x1b[%dB", numRows)
	out.WriteString("\n")
	out.Flush()
}
GOEOF

        stdin=stdin_r, stdout=slave_fd, stderr=slave_fd,
        env=env, close_fds=True, preexec_fn=preexec)
    os.close(slave_fd); os.close(stdin_r)
    all_data = b''

    def reader():
        nonlocal all_data
        deadline = time.time() + 6
        while time.time() < deadline:
            r, _, _ = select.select([master_fd], [], [], 0.1)
            if r:
                try:
                    chunk = os.read(master_fd, 65536)
                    if chunk: all_data += chunk
                except: break

    rt = threading.Thread(target=reader); rt.daemon=True; rt.start()

        os.write(master_fd, b'\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize=15.0;8.0\x07')

            time.sleep(1.1)

    t = threading.Thread(target=writer); t.daemon=True; t.start()
    time.sleep(5); proc.terminate(); t.join(timeout=1); rt.join(timeout=1)

    pos = 0
    clean = b''
    img_count = 0
    while pos < len(all_data):
        idx = all_data.find(b'\x1b]1337;File=', pos)
        if idx < 0:
            clean += all_data[pos:]

        clean += all_data[pos:idx]
        end = all_data.find(b'\x07', idx)
        if end < 0: break
        img_count += 1
        clean += f'[IMG_{img_count}]'.encode()
        pos = end + 1
    
    return clean, img_count

# With the non-preexec test (first time), with setsid+TIOCSCTTY:

# That's 2 images! And the earlier count of 3 was from a different timing.

# Let me recheck the count vs data points:
python3 << 'PYEOF'
import pty, os, subprocess, sys, time, threading, select

def test(n, data_delay=1.1):
    master_fd, slave_fd = pty.openpty()
    import fcntl, termios, struct
    sz = struct.pack("HHHH", 24, 80, 0, 0)
    fcntl.ioctl(slave_fd, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, sz)
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env['TERM_PROGRAM'] = 'iTerm.app'
    stdin_r, stdin_w = os.pipe()
    def preexec():
        os.setsid()
        fcntl.ioctl(slave_fd, termios.TIOCSCTTY, 0)
    proc = subprocess.Popen(['./executable', '-steps', '5', 'a'],
        stdin=stdin_r, stdout=slave_fd, stderr=slave_fd, env=env,
        close_fds=True, preexec_fn=preexec)
    os.close(slave_fd); os.close(stdin_r)
    all_data = b''
    def reader():
        nonlocal all_data
        deadline = time.time() + n*data_delay + 3
        while time.time() < deadline:
            r, _, _ = select.select([master_fd], [], [], 0.1)
            if r:
                try:
                    chunk = os.read(master_fd, 65536)
                    if chunk: all_data += chunk
                except: break
    rt = threading.Thread(target=reader); rt.daemon=True; rt.start()
    def writer():
        time.sleep(0.3)
        os.write(master_fd, b'\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize=15.0;8.0\x07')
        time.sleep(0.5)
        for i in range(n):
            os.write(stdin_w, b'{"a": 50}\n')
            time.sleep(data_delay)
        os.close(stdin_w)
    t = threading.Thread(target=writer); t.daemon=True; t.start()
    time.sleep(n*data_delay + 2); proc.terminate(); t.join(timeout=1); rt.join(timeout=1)
    return all_data.count(b'\x1b]1337;File=')

print("Original image counts (data_delay=1.1s):")
for n in range(1, 8):
    c = test(n)
    print(f"  n={n}: {c} images")

import pty, os, subprocess, sys, time, threading, select

master_fd, slave_fd = pty.openpty()
import fcntl, termios, struct
sz = struct.pack("HHHH", 24, 80, 0, 0)
fcntl.ioctl(slave_fd, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, sz)
env = os.environ.copy()
env['TERM_PROGRAM'] = 'iTerm.app'
stdin_r, stdin_w = os.pipe()

def preexec():
    os.setsid()
    fcntl.ioctl(slave_fd, termios.TIOCSCTTY, 0)

# n=3 data points -> 4 images (the 4th is "final" at cleanup time)
proc = subprocess.Popen(['./executable', '-steps', '5', 'a'],
    stdin=stdin_r, stdout=slave_fd, stderr=slave_fd, env=env,
    close_fds=True, preexec_fn=preexec)
os.close(slave_fd); os.close(stdin_r)
chunks = []

def reader():
    deadline = time.time() + 8
    while time.time() < deadline:
        r, _, _ = select.select([master_fd], [], [], 0.02)
        if r:
            try:
                chunk = os.read(master_fd, 65536)
                if chunk: chunks.append((time.time(), chunk))
            except: break

rt = threading.Thread(target=reader); rt.daemon=True; rt.start()
t0 = time.time()

def writer():
    time.sleep(0.3)
    os.write(master_fd, b'\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize=15.0;8.0\x07')

    for i in range(3):
        os.write(stdin_w, b'{"a": 50}\n')
        time.sleep(1.1)
    os.close(stdin_w)

time.sleep(7); proc.terminate(); t.join(timeout=1); rt.join(timeout=1)

clean = b''

    clean += all_data[pos:idx]
    end = all_data.find(b'\x07', idx)
    if end < 0: break
    img_count += 1
    clean += f'[IMG_{img_count}]'.encode()
    pos = end + 1

package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"encoding/base64"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

// iTerm2 Terminal implementation
type ITerm2Terminal struct {
	cellW        float64
	cellH        float64
	renderCount  int
}

func (t *ITerm2Terminal) GetSize() (cols, rows int, err error) {
	ws, err := getWinsize()
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("inappropriate ioctl for device")
	}
	return int(ws.Col), int(ws.Row), nil
}

func (t *ITerm2Terminal) GetPixelSize(cols, rows, rowsFlag int) (int, int, error) {
	origState, _ := makeRaw()
	
	fmt.Fprint(os.Stdout, "\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize\x07")
	os.Stdout.Sync()
	
	resp := readTTYUntilBEL(500)
	
	if origState != nil {
		restoreRaw(origState)
	}
	
	if idx := strings.Index(resp, "ReportCellSize="); idx >= 0 {
		parts := strings.Split(resp[idx+len("ReportCellSize="):], ";")
		if len(parts) >= 2 {
			h, _ := strconv.ParseFloat(strings.TrimRight(parts[0], "\x07"), 64)
			w2, _ := strconv.ParseFloat(strings.TrimRight(parts[1], "\x07"), 64)
			t.cellH = h
			t.cellW = w2
		}
	}

	if t.cellH == 0 || t.cellW == 0 {
		ws, err := getWinsize()
		if err == nil && ws.Xpixel > 0 && ws.Ypixel > 0 {
			t.cellW = float64(ws.Xpixel) / float64(ws.Col)
			t.cellH = float64(ws.Ypixel) / float64(ws.Row)
		} else {
			t.cellW = 8
			t.cellH = 15
		}
	}

	imgW := int(t.cellW * float64(cols))
	numRows := rowsFlag
	if numRows == 0 {
		numRows = rows
	}
	imgH := int(t.cellH * float64(numRows))

	return imgW, imgH, nil
}

func (t *ITerm2Terminal) Setup(numRows int) {
	out := bufio.NewWriter(os.Stdout)
	out.WriteString("\x1b[?25l")
	for i := 0; i < numRows; i++ {
		out.WriteString("\n")
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(out, "\x1b[%dA", numRows)
	out.WriteString("\x1b[s")
	// Send cell size query (response will be read asynchronously)
	out.WriteString("\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize\x07")
	out.Flush()
	t.renderCount = 0
}

func (t *ITerm2Terminal) DisplayImage(imgData []byte, w, h int, isLast bool) error {
	out := bufio.NewWriter(os.Stdout)
	
	// Save cursor before each render (except the very first, which is already saved by Setup)
	if t.renderCount > 0 {
		out.WriteString("\x1b[s")
	}
	t.renderCount++
	
	encoded := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(imgData)
	fmt.Fprintf(out, "\x1b]1337;File=preserveAspectRatio=1;width=%dpx;height=%dpx;inline=1:", w, h)
	out.WriteString(encoded)
	out.WriteString("\x07")
	out.WriteString("\x1b[u")
	out.Flush()
	return nil
}

func (t *ITerm2Terminal) Cleanup(numRows int) {
	out := bufio.NewWriter(os.Stdout)
	out.WriteString("\x1b[?25h")
	fmt.Fprintf(out, "\x1b[%dB", numRows)
	out.WriteString("\r\n")
	out.Flush()
}

            if r:
                try:

                    if chunk: all_data += chunk
                except: break

    master_fd, slave_fd = pty.openpty()
    import fcntl, termios, struct
    sz = struct.pack("HHHH", 24, 80, 0, 0)
    fcntl.ioctl(slave_fd, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, sz)

    env['TERM_PROGRAM'] = 'iTerm.app'

    def preexec():

        close_fds=True, preexec_fn=preexec)
    os.close(slave_fd); os.close(stdin_r)
    all_data = b''
    def reader():
        nonlocal all_data
        deadline = time.time() + n_data*1.1 + 3
        while time.time() < deadline:
            r, _, _ = select.select([master_fd], [], [], 0.1)
            if r:
                try:
                    chunk = os.read(master_fd, 65536)
                    if chunk: all_data += chunk
                except: break
    rt = threading.Thread(target=reader); rt.daemon=True; rt.start()

        time.sleep(0.3)
        os.write(master_fd, b'\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize=15.0;8.0\x07')

            os.write(stdin_w, b'{"a": 50}\n')
            time.sleep(1.1)

    print(f"  Match: imgs_orig={orig.count(b'[IMG')}, imgs_mine={mine.count(b'[IMG')}")
    print()

    fcntl.ioctl(slave_fd, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, sz)
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env['TERM_PROGRAM'] = 'iTerm.app'

    def preexec():
        os.setsid()

            if r:
                try:
                    chunk = os.read(master_fd, 65536)
                    if chunk: all_data += chunk

import pty, os, subprocess, sys, time, threading, select, struct, base64, zlib

def get_image(exe, spec, data_values):
    master_fd, slave_fd = pty.openpty()
    import fcntl, termios
    sz = struct.pack("HHHH", 24, 80, 0, 0)
    fcntl.ioctl(slave_fd, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, sz)
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env['TERM_PROGRAM'] = 'iTerm.app'
    stdin_r, stdin_w = os.pipe()
    def preexec():
        os.setsid()
        fcntl.ioctl(slave_fd, termios.TIOCSCTTY, 0)
    proc = subprocess.Popen([exe, '-steps', '10', spec],
        stdin=stdin_r, stdout=slave_fd, stderr=slave_fd, env=env,
        close_fds=True, preexec_fn=preexec)
    os.close(slave_fd); os.close(stdin_r)
    all_data = b''
    def reader():
        nonlocal all_data
        deadline = time.time() + len(data_values)*1.1 + 3
        while time.time() < deadline:
            r, _, _ = select.select([master_fd], [], [], 0.1)
            if r:
                try:
                    chunk = os.read(master_fd, 65536)
                    if chunk: all_data += chunk
                except: break
    rt = threading.Thread(target=reader); rt.daemon=True; rt.start()
    def writer():
        time.sleep(0.3)
        os.write(master_fd, b'\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize=15.0;8.0\x07')
        time.sleep(0.5)
        for v in data_values:
            os.write(stdin_w, f'{{"a": {v}}}\n'.encode())
            time.sleep(1.1)
        os.close(stdin_w)
    t = threading.Thread(target=writer); t.daemon=True; t.start()
    time.sleep(len(data_values)*1.2 + 2); proc.terminate(); t.join(timeout=1); rt.join(timeout=1)
    
    # Get LAST image
    prefix = b'\x1b]1337;File='
    images = []
    pos = 0
    while True:
        idx = all_data.find(prefix, pos)
        if idx < 0: break
        he = all_data.find(b':', idx)
        ep = all_data.find(b'\x07', idx)
        try: images.append(base64.b64decode(all_data[he+1:ep]))
        except: pass
        pos = ep+1
    return images[-1] if images else None

orig_img = get_image('./executable', 'a', [10, 20, 30, 40, 50])

if orig_img and mine_img:
    # Compare image sizes
    orig_w = struct.unpack('>I', orig_img[16:20])[0]
    orig_h = struct.unpack('>I', orig_img[20:24])[0]
    mine_w = struct.unpack('>I', mine_img[16:20])[0]
    mine_h = struct.unpack('>I', mine_img[20:24])[0]
    print(f"Orig: {orig_w}x{orig_h} ({len(orig_img)} bytes)")
    print(f"Mine: {mine_w}x{mine_h} ({len(mine_img)} bytes)")
    
    # Compare some pixels
    def decode_png(png_data):
        pos = 8
        idat = b''
        while pos < len(png_data) - 12:
            cl = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[pos:pos+4])[0]
            ct = png_data[pos+4:pos+8]
            cd = png_data[pos+8:pos+8+cl]
            pos += 12 + cl
            if ct == b'IDAT': idat += cd
        w = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[16:20])[0]
        h = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[20:24])[0]
        raw = zlib.decompress(idat)
        channels = 4
        row_size = 1 + channels * w
        rows = []
        for y in range(h):
            rs = y * row_size
            f = raw[rs]
            row = bytearray(raw[rs+1:rs+1+channels*w])
            if f == 1:
                for x in range(channels, len(row)): row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels]) & 0xFF
            elif f == 2:
                if y > 0:
                    prev = rows[-1]
                    for x in range(len(row)): row[x] = (row[x] + prev[x]) & 0xFF
            elif f == 3:
                if y > 0:
                    prev = rows[-1]
                    for x in range(len(row)):
                        a = row[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                        row[x] = (row[x] + (a + prev[x]) // 2) & 0xFF
                else:
                    for x in range(channels, len(row)): row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels] // 2) & 0xFF
            elif f == 4:
                if y > 0:
                    prev = rows[-1]
                    for x in range(len(row)):
                        a = row[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                        b = prev[x]; c = prev[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                        p = a + b - c; pa, pb, pc = abs(p-a), abs(p-b), abs(p-c)
                        pr = a if (pa <= pb and pa <= pc) else (b if pb <= pc else c)
                        row[x] = (row[x] + pr) & 0xFF
                else:
                    for x in range(channels, len(row)): row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels]) & 0xFF
            rows.append(bytes(row))
        def get(x, y):
            row = rows[y]
            return tuple(row[x*4:x*4+4])
        return w, h, get
    
    ow, oh, get_orig = decode_png(orig_img)
    mw, mh, get_mine = decode_png(mine_img)
    
    # Find where the data line is
    print("\nOrig pixel scan (right side x=580):")
    for y in range(0, oh, 5):
        p = get_orig(580, y)
        if p[3] > 200 and not (p[0]>200 and p[1]>200 and p[2]>200):
            print(f"  y={y}: {p}")
    
    with open('/tmp/orig_chart.png', 'wb') as f:
        f.write(orig_img)
    with open('/tmp/mine_chart.png', 'wb') as f:
        f.write(mine_img)
    print("\nSaved to /tmp/orig_chart.png and /tmp/mine_chart.png")

func (c *Canvas) setPixel(x, y int, col color.RGBA) {
	if x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= c.W || y >= c.H {
		return
	}
	// Alpha compositing: src over dst
	src := col
	dst := c.img.RGBAAt(x, y)
	
	if dst.A == 0 {
		c.img.SetRGBA(x, y, src)
		return
	}
	
	srcA := float64(src.A) / 255.0
	dstA := float64(dst.A) / 255.0
	outA := srcA + dstA*(1-srcA)
	if outA < 1e-9 {
		return
	}
	
	outR := (srcA*float64(src.R) + dstA*(1-srcA)*float64(dst.R)) / outA
	outG := (srcA*float64(src.G) + dstA*(1-srcA)*float64(dst.G)) / outA
	outB := (srcA*float64(src.B) + dstA*(1-srcA)*float64(dst.B)) / outA
	
	c.img.SetRGBA(x, y, color.RGBA{
		R: uint8(math.Min(255, outR)),
		G: uint8(math.Min(255, outG)),
		B: uint8(math.Min(255, outB)),
		A: uint8(math.Min(255, outA*255)),
	})
}

func drawSeries(canvas *Canvas, data []float64, count, steps, numPoints, x0, x1, y0, y1, plotW, plotH int, minVal, maxVal float64, col color.RGBA) {
	if numPoints < 1 {
		return
	}

	fillCol := color.RGBA{R: col.R, G: col.G, B: col.B, A: 20}

	prevX := -1.0
	prevY := -1.0
	
	for i := 0; i < numPoints; i++ {
		pos := (count - numPoints + i) % steps
		v := data[pos]
		if math.IsNaN(v) {
			prevX = -1
			prevY = -1
			continue
		}
		
		// Map to pixel coordinates
		xf := float64(x0) + float64(i)*float64(plotW)/float64(steps-1)
		yNorm := (v - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal)
		yf := float64(y1) - yNorm*float64(plotH)
		
		// Fill below the line
		yFillStart := int(yf)
		if yFillStart < y0 {
			yFillStart = y0
		}
		for y := yFillStart; y <= y1; y++ {
			canvas.setPixel(int(xf), y, fillCol)
		}
		
		// Draw line segment
		if prevX >= 0 {
			canvas.drawLineAA(prevX, prevY, xf, yf, col)
		}
		
		prevX = xf
		prevY = yf
	}
}

			canvas.setPixel(xf, y, markerCol)
		}
	}
}

import struct, zlib

    pos = 8; idat = b''
    while pos < len(data) - 12:
        cl = struct.unpack('>I', data[pos:pos+4])[0]
        ct = data[pos+4:pos+8]; cd = data[pos+8:pos+8+cl]
        pos += 12 + cl
        if ct == b'IDAT': idat += cd
    w = struct.unpack('>I', data[16:20])[0]; h = struct.unpack('>I', data[20:24])[0]
    raw = zlib.decompress(idat)
    channels = 4; row_size = 1 + channels * w; rows = []
    for y in range(h):
        rs = y * row_size; f = raw[rs]; row = bytearray(raw[rs+1:rs+1+channels*w])
        if f == 2:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]

    raw = zlib.decompress(idat)

    for y in range(h):
        rs = y * row_size; f = raw[rs]; row = bytearray(raw[rs+1:rs+1+channels*w])

            for x in range(channels, len(row)): row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels]) & 0xFF
        elif f == 2:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                for x in range(len(row)): row[x] = (row[x] + prev[x]) & 0xFF
        elif f == 4:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                for x in range(len(row)):
                    a = row[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0; b = prev[x]; c = prev[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0

    for x in [100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 580, 600]:
        for y in range(h):
            r, g, b, a = get(x, y)
            if a > 200 and g > 50 and b > 100:
                print(f'  x={x}: y={y}, RGBA({r},{g},{b},{a})')
                break

import struct, zlib, base64
import pty, os, subprocess, time, threading, select

def get_image(exe, data_values, steps=10):
    master_fd, slave_fd = pty.openpty()
    import fcntl, termios
    sz = struct.pack("HHHH", 24, 80, 0, 0)
    fcntl.ioctl(slave_fd, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, sz)
    env = os.environ.copy(); env['TERM_PROGRAM'] = 'iTerm.app'
    stdin_r, stdin_w = os.pipe()
    def preexec(): os.setsid(); fcntl.ioctl(slave_fd, termios.TIOCSCTTY, 0)
    proc = subprocess.Popen([exe, f'-steps={steps}', 'a'],
        stdin=stdin_r, stdout=slave_fd, stderr=slave_fd, env=env, close_fds=True, preexec_fn=preexec)
    os.close(slave_fd); os.close(stdin_r)
    all_data = b''
    def reader():
        nonlocal all_data
        deadline = time.time() + len(data_values)*1.1 + 3
        while time.time() < deadline:
            r, _, _ = select.select([master_fd], [], [], 0.1)
            if r:
                try:
                    chunk = os.read(master_fd, 65536)
                    if chunk: all_data += chunk
                except: break
    rt = threading.Thread(target=reader); rt.daemon=True; rt.start()
    def writer():
        time.sleep(0.3)
        os.write(master_fd, b'\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize=15.0;8.0\x07')
        time.sleep(0.5)
        for v in data_values:
            os.write(stdin_w, f'{{"a": {v}}}\n'.encode())
            time.sleep(1.1)
        os.close(stdin_w)
    t = threading.Thread(target=writer); t.daemon=True; t.start()
    time.sleep(len(data_values)*1.2 + 2); proc.terminate(); t.join(timeout=1); rt.join(timeout=1)
    prefix = b'\x1b]1337;File='
    images = []
    pos = 0
    while True:
        idx = all_data.find(prefix, pos)
        if idx < 0: break
        he = all_data.find(b':', idx)
        ep = all_data.find(b'\x07', idx)
        try: images.append(base64.b64decode(all_data[he+1:ep]))
        except: pass
        pos = ep+1
    return images[-1] if images else None

def decode_quick(png_data):
    pos = 8; idat = b''
    while pos < len(png_data) - 12:
        cl = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[pos:pos+4])[0]
        ct = png_data[pos+4:pos+8]; cd = png_data[pos+8:pos+8+cl]
        pos += 12 + cl
        if ct == b'IDAT': idat += cd
    w = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[16:20])[0]; h = struct.unpack('>I', png_data[20:24])[0]
    raw = zlib.decompress(idat)
    channels = 4; row_size = 1 + channels * w; rows = []
    for y in range(h):
        rs = y * row_size; f = raw[rs]; row = bytearray(raw[rs+1:rs+1+channels*w])
        if f == 1:
            for x in range(channels, len(row)): row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-channels]) & 0xFF
        elif f == 2:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                for x in range(len(row)): row[x] = (row[x] + prev[x]) & 0xFF
        elif f == 4:
            if y > 0:
                prev = rows[-1]
                for x in range(len(row)):
                    a = row[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0; b = prev[x]; c = prev[x-channels] if x >= channels else 0
                    p = a+b-c; pa,pb,pc = abs(p-a),abs(p-b),abs(p-c)
                    row[x] = (row[x]+(a if (pa<=pb and pa<=pc) else (b if pb<=pc else c))) & 0xFF
        rows.append(bytes(row))
    def get(x, y): row = rows[y]; return tuple(row[x*4:x*4+4])
    return w, h, get

img = get_image('./executable', [10, 20, 30, 40, 50], 10)
w, h, get = decode_quick(img)

# Check line positions at expected x values
print("Orig line at expected x positions:")
for x, expected_y in [(339, 269.6), (404, 205.2), (469, 140.8), (535, 76.4), (600, 12.0)]:
    # Find first high-alpha blue pixel
    for y in range(h):
        r, g, b, a = get(x, y)
        if a > 200 and g > 50 and b > 100 and r < 50:
            print(f"  x={x} (expected y={expected_y:.0f}): actual y={y}")
            break

import pty, os, subprocess, time, threading, select, struct, base64, zlib

def get_image_line(exe, data_values, steps=10):
    master_fd, slave_fd = pty.openpty()
    import fcntl, termios
    sz = struct.pack("HHHH", 24, 80, 0, 0)
    fcntl.ioctl(slave_fd, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, sz)
    env = os.environ.copy(); env['TERM_PROGRAM'] = 'iTerm.app'
    stdin_r, stdin_w = os.pipe()
    def preexec(): os.setsid(); fcntl.ioctl(slave_fd, termios.TIOCSCTTY, 0)
    proc = subprocess.Popen([exe, f'-steps={steps}', 'a'],
        stdin=stdin_r, stdout=slave_fd, stderr=slave_fd, env=env, close_fds=True, preexec_fn=preexec)
    os.close(slave_fd); os.close(stdin_r)
    all_data = b''
    def reader():
        nonlocal all_data
        deadline = time.time() + len(data_values)*1.1 + 3
        while time.time() < deadline:
            r, _, _ = select.select([master_fd], [], [], 0.1)
            if r:
                try:
                    chunk = os.read(master_fd, 65536)
                    if chunk: all_data += chunk
                except: break
    rt = threading.Thread(target=reader); rt.daemon=True; rt.start()
    def writer():
        time.sleep(0.3)
        os.write(master_fd, b'\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize=15.0;8.0\x07')
        time.sleep(0.5)
        for v in data_values:
            os.write(stdin_w, f'{{"a": {v}}}\n'.encode())
            time.sleep(1.1)
        os.close(stdin_w)
    t = threading.Thread(target=writer); t.daemon=True; t.start()
    time.sleep(len(data_values)*1.2 + 2); proc.terminate(); t.join(timeout=1); rt.join(timeout=1)
    
    prefix = b'\x1b]1337;File='
    images = []
    pos = 0
    while True:
        idx = all_data.find(prefix, pos)
        if idx < 0: break
        he = all_data.find(b':', idx)
        ep = all_data.find(b'\x07', idx)
        try: images.append(base64.b64decode(all_data[he+1:ep]))
        except: pass
        pos = ep+1
    img = images[-1] if images else None
    if not img: return {}
    
    pos = 8; idat = b''
    while pos < len(img) - 12:

        ct = img[pos+4:pos+8]; cd = img[pos+8:pos+8+cl]

    w = struct.unpack('>I', img[16:20])[0]; h = struct.unpack('>I', img[20:24])[0]

    for y in range(h):

# Let me update detectTerminal:

echo "Fixing terminal detection order"

# Orig gets past window size and reaches data validation

# This is because the original checks the tty that the shell is connected to.
# When run as: echo | ./executable
# stdin is a pipe, but stdout/stderr are still connected to the terminal.
# TIOCGWINSZ on stdout or stderr works!
# 
# In my implementation, I try:
# 1. os.Stdout.Fd() for TIOCGWINSZ
# 2. tty.Fd() for TIOCGWINSZ
# 
# But when running echo | ./executable, with TERM_PROGRAM=iTerm.app:
# - stdin is a pipe
# - stdout is also a pipe (piped to cat in my test) OR a terminal when run directly
#

		fmt.Fprint(os.Stderr, "jplot:  neither --url nor stdin is provided\\n")

# The --bad-flag test differs because:
# Original: starts with ESC[c then error+help
# Mine: no ESC[c before the error (since it's a flag parsing error)
# 
# The difference: the original sends ESC[c BEFORE flag.Parse(), mine doesn't.
# 
# But wait: if TERM_PROGRAM is NOT set, the original would call queryDAFull which sends ESC[c.
# But flag.Parse() exits with code 2 BEFORE detectTerminal() is called...
# 
# OH! The original sends ESC[c BEFORE flag.Parse()!
# The ESC[c is sent at the very start of main(), before ANYTHING else.
# BUT it only does this when the terminal detection would need it (i.e., when
# TERM_PROGRAM is not set to iTerm.app).
# 
# Actually looking at the bad-flag test:
# Original: ESC[c + flag-error + help
# Mine: flag-error + help (no ESC[c)
# 
# This means the ORIGINAL sends ESC[c BEFORE flag.Parse() when no TERM_PROGRAM is set.
# 
# Let me add the ESC[c at startup ONLY when TERM_PROGRAM is not "iTerm.app":

python3 << 'EOF'
with open('/workspace/jplot/main.go', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

old = '''	// Start ticker immediately (before setup and GetPixelSize)
	ticker := time.NewTicker(time.Second)
	defer ticker.Stop()'''

new = '''	// Send ESC[c query at startup when terminal detection might need it
	// (i.e., when not using iTerm.app which is detected by env var alone)
	if os.Getenv("TERM_PROGRAM") != "iTerm.app" {
		fmt.Fprint(os.Stdout, "\\x1b[c")
		os.Stdout.Sync()
	}

	// Start ticker immediately (before setup and GetPixelSize)
	ticker := time.NewTicker(time.Second)
	defer ticker.Stop()'''

if old in content:
    content = content.replace(old, new)
    with open('/workspace/jplot/main.go', 'w') as f:
        f.write(content)
    print("SUCCESS")
else:
    print("FAILED")
    idx = content.find('ticker := time.NewTicker')
    print(repr(content[max(0,idx-100):idx+50]))
EOF

        env=env, close_fds=True, preexec_fn=preexec)
    os.close(slave_fd); os.close(stdin_r)
    all_data = b''
    def reader():
        nonlocal all_data
        deadline = time.time() + n_data*1.1 + 3
        while time.time() < deadline:
            r, _, _ = select.select([master_fd], [], [], 0.1)
            if r:
                try:
                    chunk = os.read(master_fd, 65536)
                    if chunk: all_data += chunk
                except: break
    rt = threading.Thread(target=reader); rt.daemon=True; rt.start()
